prompt:
The section file sections/lookbook-tag-strip.liquid renders lookbook entries. Each entry shows its title followed by its comma-separated tags, joined with a separator the merchant chooses. The markup is correct, so do not change it. The schema is wrong: the separator is a free-text field, the tags setting is a textarea without guidance, and there is no preset. Replace the schema with exactly the following.

Top-level keys, in this order:
- "name": "Lookbook"
- "tag": "section"
- "max_blocks": 6 (an integer)
- "settings"
- "blocks"
- "presets"

"settings" is an array of exactly two settings, in this order:
1. type "text", id "heading", label "Heading", default "Lookbook".
2. type "select", id "separator", label "Tag separator". Its options are, in order:
   - {value ", ", label "Comma"}: a comma followed by one space.
   - {value " / ", label "Slash"}: a space, a slash and a space.
   - {value " | ", label "Pipe"}: a space, a pipe and a space.
   Its default is " / ".
   Keep the spaces exactly as given, because the values are passed directly to join.

"blocks" is an array with exactly one block. The block has type "look" and name "Look". Its "settings" array contains exactly these settings, in this order:
1. type "text", id "title", label "Title", default "Look".
2. type "text", id "tags", label "Tags", info "Separate tags with commas". This setting has no default.

"presets" is an array with exactly one preset. The preset has name "Lookbook" and a "blocks" array containing three entries, each {"type": "look"}.

Do not add any other keys. Change only sections/lookbook-tag-strip.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
